answers.core: Yes. Splash screens are part of the standard app startup experience. Having it built into the Android template ensures all projects work out-of-the-box without error-prone manual configuration.
answers.workaround:
It requires following the settings from https://github.com/MiqueiasDevGames/Godot-SplashScreen-Android-12
, so it is not a simple few lines of script.

There was a similar issue before: https://github.com/godotengine/godot-proposals/issues/4221
, but the problem was never resolved.

title: Add an option to use native Android splash screen instead of Godot's own splash screen implementation
